paragraphs: All participants, tables and records are fictional. Participant identifiers are scoped to this study; exact (source table, identifier) assignments link the four sources.
Activity intervals use UTC, include their start and exclude their end. Daily totals refer to a UTC calendar day. Counts from separate devices are retained separately.
Only two exact, non-overlapping Stride half-day intervals on 3 February may produce a daily sum. Participant 02 has only one supplied half-day interval, so no full-day result is derived.
Sleep dates identify the UTC date on which the reference night began. Device estimates are durations in minutes; diary answers remain strings reporting hours slept. Missing values remain absent.

The sleep-comparison question converts numeric diary hours to minutes under its stated question meaning. It does not turn a response into a sensor measurement or establish equivalence between reported and estimated sleep.
